'''Docking bay 1831''' was located at [[Gallisport]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]]. The [[PB-950 patrol boat]] ''[[Lumrunner]]'' docked in the bay during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Lumrunners}}</ref>
